rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for both “thoroughly” and “totally,” including “completely mad.”

example.english: This room has been completely emptied.
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 uk1 jyun4 cyun4 cing1 hung1 laa3

rows.note: Use this for carrying something through thoroughly or leaving nothing undone, especially with actions or changes.

example.english: We need to completely reform this system.
example.traditional: 我哋要徹底改革呢個制度。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 cit3 dai2 goi2 gaak3 ni1 go3 zai3 dou6

rows.note: Use this colloquial construction when an action is done to the whole amount or all relevant items, rather than to emphasize thoroughness.

example.english: They completely ate all the fish on the plate.
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 sik6 saai3 dip6 jyu4 laa3
